    Changelog

    0.2.0 - 2026-08-02

    Added

    • Panel-local LIFO popups through UIPopupHost and the pure C# UIPopupStack.
    • Show and ShowAsync with VisualTreeAsset, data source, and configure callback inputs.
    • UIPopupView, UIPopupBackdrop, UIPopupContent, and UIPopupActionButton UXML elements.
    • NavElement startup settings and automatic hiding after Show completion.
    • Category/Variant transition presets with Move, Rotate, Scale, and Fade channels.
    • Time scale, scene load/activate/unload, and application quit action nodes.

    Changed

    • Standardized view element names as NavElement, NavButton, and NavToggle.
    • Replaced project-wide LINQ calls with allocation-free ZLinq APIs.
    • Set Unity 6.6 as the recommended baseline.

    Removed

    • Removed the previous popup Catalog, global Host, and queue-based APIs.

    0.1.0 - 2026-07-28

    • Added Graph Toolkit .uinavgraph authoring and runtime asset import.
    • Added UINavigatorBehaviour, the view registry, Key Catalog, and UI Builder address pickers.
